regularity.author: Camille Martin
regularity.text: Easily the app that has helped me stay consistent the most. I eat better, my meals actually fill me up, and I no longer have to calculate every recipe myself.

macros.author: Lucas Bernard
macros.text: A real game changer. I enter my goals and the app gives me tailored recipes with calories and protein. I couldn’t go back to the way I used to do things.

simplicity.author: Emma Laurent
simplicity.text: Finally, a nutrition app I actually want to open every day. Beautiful, simple, and above all, genuinely useful.

time.author: Julie Moreau
time.text: This app saves me so much time every week. No more spending hours looking for recipes or calculating macros ingredient by ingredient. It’s all done already.

planning.author: Alexandre Petit
planning.text: Honestly, it’s become my personal meal assistant. I know what to eat, what to buy, and how to stay on track with my goals.

training.author: Thomas Renaud
training.text: If you watch what you eat or work out, this app belongs on your phone. It’s simple, fast, and incredibly handy.
